annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people on the main line, a screen saying the siding was clear.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd have to accept that my choice sent the train onto that person.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I think I'd carry that result for a long time.

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Doing nothing meant five deaths, almost certainly.
annotations.pda_responsibility: it was my decision that moved the danger onto someone

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Judge people by what they knew.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The operator knew five were in danger
annotations.pda_responsibility: the death on the siding would trace back to me.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The operator was reaching for five alive and none dead
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: that's what the screen told them they'd get.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd have to live knowing I was the one who redirected the train
my trust in that display would have been part of why someone died.
annotations.pd_harm_distress: a quiet, heavy thing to sit with.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: People will want someone to blame
annotations.pda_responsibility: the person on the siding would be dead because I moved the points.

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: Part of me flinches at the switch itself.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: the choice was five deaths versus none. I'd switch.
annotations.pda_responsibility: the death would still follow from my hand
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Its cost landed on someone who never had a say.

annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd own that it was my diversion that put the train
annotations.ce_understood_harm: Five families keep someone. One doesn't.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I understand why they'd feel sick about it.

annotations.pda_responsibility: my decision would be the link between a broken screen and a death.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: holding back would have meant accepting five deaths

annotations.sys_rule_justification: Operators have to trust their instruments, or nothing works.
annotations.pda_responsibility: my trust and my action together would have produced that death.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: The five are alive because of that same choice.
